description: UNICA Agent Performance - response time, conversation volume, satisfaction scores per agent

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM first_agent_reply_at - handoff_at)) FILTER (WHERE first_agent_reply_at IS NOT NULL AND handoff_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS avg_response_seconds FROM conversations WHERE assigned_agent_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo() AND ($product_line = '' OR product_line_id::text = '$product_line')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM conversations WHERE assigned_agent_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo() AND ($product_line = '' OR product_line_id::text = '$product_line')

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(satisfaction_score) FILTER (WHERE satisfaction_score IS NOT NULL), 0) AS avg_satisfaction FROM conversations WHERE assigned_agent_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo() AND ($product_line = '' OR product_line_id::text = '$product_line')

SELECT assigned_agent_id::text, COALESCE(a.name, assigned_agent_id::text) AS agent, COUNT(*) AS active_count FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id = c.assigned_agent_id WHERE c.state = 'human_processing' AND c.assigned_agent_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.assigned_agent_id, a.name ORDER BY active_count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(a.name, c.assigned_agent_id::text) AS agent_name, COUNT(*) AS conversation_count, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM c.first_agent_reply_at - c.handoff_at)) FILTER (WHERE c.first_agent_reply_at IS NOT NULL AND c.handoff_at IS NOT NULL), 0)::numeric, 1) AS avg_response_seconds, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(c.satisfaction_score) FILTER (WHERE c.satisfaction_score IS NOT NULL), 0)::numeric, 2) AS avg_satisfaction FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id = c.assigned_agent_id WHERE c.assigned_agent_id IS NOT NULL AND c.created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND c.created_at < $__timeTo() AND ($product_line = '' OR c.product_line_id::text = '$product_line') GROUP BY c.assigned_agent_id, a.name ORDER BY conversation_count DESC

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM first_agent_reply_at - handoff_at)) FILTER (WHERE first_agent_reply_at IS NOT NULL AND handoff_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS avg_response_seconds FROM conversations WHERE assigned_agent_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo() AND ($product_line = '' OR product_line_id::text = '$product_line') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', c.created_at) AS time, COALESCE(a.name, c.assigned_agent_id::text) AS agent, COUNT(*) AS conversations FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id = c.assigned_agent_id WHERE c.assigned_agent_id IS NOT NULL AND c.created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND c.created_at < $__timeTo() AND ($product_line = '' OR c.product_line_id::text = '$product_line') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT satisfaction_score::text AS score, COUNT(*) AS count FROM conversations WHERE satisfaction_score IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo() AND ($product_line = '' OR product_line_id::text = '$product_line') GROUP BY satisfaction_score ORDER BY satisfaction_score

SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, COALESCE(AVG(satisfaction_score) FILTER (WHERE satisfaction_score IS NOT NULL), 0) AS avg_satisfaction FROM conversations WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo() AND ($product_line = '' OR product_line_id::text = '$product_line') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

list.name: product_line
list.label: Product Line
list.query: SELECT id::text AS __value, name AS __text FROM product_lines ORDER BY name
